canada.title: Drinking water advisory lifted for Sambaa K'e, N.W.T.
canada.summary: Officials said the advisory, issued on Sep. 16, was in place as a "precautionary" measure after a toxin related to blue-green algae was detected in the water. A news release on Thursday said tap water can now be used as normal.

canada.title: New faces on Steinbach, Man., city council include its 1st person of colour
canada.summary: Voters in Steinbach, Man., elected two new members to council Wednesday, including the first councillor of colour in the historically Mennonite and fast-growing city.

canada.title: Mother rejects Sask. police watchdog report clearing RCMP officers in her son's death
canada.summary: The mother of a 29-year-old man who died on James Smith says a violent arrest played a part in his death and disagrees with the findings of an investigation conducted by the Saskatchewan Serious Incident Response Team. Nicole Sanderson says RCMP did not take her son's pleas for help seriously until he went unconscious.

canada.title: Halifax police board calls for return of RCMP offices, explores municipal police stepping in

canada.title: N.S. university teachers association says premier is using political intimidation
canada.summary: While Premier Tim Houston said he's glad a staffer in his office sent a complaint to a Toronto professor who had commented on a proposed artificial intelligence data centre, the Association of Nova Scotia University Teachers is calling it a threat to academic freedom.

canada.title: Fire still burning at New Brunswick military base but officials say no risk to public or service members

canada.title: Apparent arson attack outside home of Sikh independence activist prompts police investigation

canada.title: Montreal police explain day-long delay in dismantling unit accused of misconduct

canada.title: No charges in fatal police shooting in Kangiqsualujjuaq, Que.
canada.summary: Quebec's Crown prosecutor's office, the DPCP, says a police officer had reasonable grounds to believe that using a firearm was necessary in the fatal shooting of a man in Kangiqsualujjuaq, Que., last year. Makivvik, the organization representing the Inuit in Nunavik, condemned the shooting.
